meta.ranking_policy: Public school-meals ranking display now uses four slots: served children, schools providing meals, coverage rate, and annual serving days. Old proxy coverage-rate display and education-enrollment rankings are removed from public ranking display.
meta.v232_policy: Four public ranking slots preserved. Coverage slot is now populated with WFP SOSF 2024 primary coverage. School count and annual serving days remain exact-data-needed.
meta.cache_update: V232 adds safe automatic version check plus manual refresh button.
